Be present physically at IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai - 600127, for the written test and/or interview.
Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification.

content_sections.text: Advt No. IIITDM/PR/JRF/A34/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIITDM Kancheepuram notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Essential: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent / Electrical Engineering or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on last date of receiving the application) Age relaxation: General Age relaxation is applicable as per GoI norms

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The post is purely on a contractual basis. The position runs till 19 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will IIITDM Kancheepuram Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Interview Written test followed by interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printed, filled and signed application form (hard copy) All educational certificates All experience certificates NOC from present employer, if currently working in Central / State / Semi-Govt / PSU / Autonomous Bodies of the Govt.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take a print of the application form, fill it in and sign it. Submit the hard copy of the application form at the time of the interview. Be present physically at IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai - 600127, for the written test and/or interview. Produce all educational and experience certificates at the time of the interview for verification. Attend on 18 November 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. For clarification on the application process, contact the PI at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on last date of receiving the application). Relaxation: General Age relaxation is applicable as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipend ₹ 37,000.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test. Interview. Written test followed by interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a contractual basis. The position runs till 19 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Printed, filled and signed application form (hard copy); All educational certificates; All experience certificates; NOC from present employer, if currently working in Central / State / Semi-Govt / PSU / Autonomous Bodies of the Govt.
